source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 4 (PDF 74-94), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Stoichiometry) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 From which words is the term stoichiometry derived? What does it mean collectively?
(Lafz stoichiometry kin alfaaz se bana hai? Majmooi taur par is ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh Greek alfaaz stoicheion (element, unsur) aur metron (measure, naap) se bana hai. Majmooi taur par stoichiometry ka matlab reactants aur products ki miqdaari (quantitative) naap hai.

book_ref.quote: Stoichiometry is derived from Greek words stoicheion means element and metron means measure

blocks.prompt:
2 Why is a balanced chemical equation needed for stoichiometric calculations?
(Stoichiometric calculations ke liye balanced chemical equation kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Balanced equation mein har qisam ke atoms dono taraf barabar hote hain, is liye yeh reactants aur products ki muqarrara nisbat (definite ratios) deti hai. Inhi nisbaton se doosre substances ka mass ya moles nikale jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: It has definite ratios of reactants and products just as compounds have definite ratios of elements

blocks.prompt:
3 How does the law of conservation of mass differ from the law of definite proportions?
(Law of conservation of mass aur law of definite proportions mein kya farq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stoichiometric calculations dono qawaneen ki pairwi karti hain; farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Stoichiometric calculations obey law of conservation of mass and law of definite proportions

rows: Maadda (mass) na paida hota hai na khatam.
Khalis compound mein elements hamesha mass ke lihaaz se aik hi nisbat mein hote hain.
Stoichiometry mein: balanced equation mein reactants ka kul mass = products ka kul mass.
Yeh aik compound ki muqarrara banawat ke baare mein hai.
Misaal: 28.0 g N₂ + 6 g H₂ → 34.0 g NH₃.
Misaal: khalis NH₃ ke har namoone mein N aur H ki mass nisbat aik hi hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 Define the mole. What can the elementary entities be?
(Mole ki definition likhein. Elementary entities kya ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mole kisi substance ki woh miqdaar hai jis mein utne elementary entities hon jitne atoms 0.012 kg (12 g) carbon-12 mein hain. Entities atoms, molecules, ions, electrons ya doosre particles ho sakte hain. Is ki alamat n hai.

book_ref.quote: The mole is the amount of a substance which contains as many elementary entities as there are atoms in 0.012 kg

blocks.prompt:
5 What is Avogadro's number? Give its value and symbol.
(Avogadro's number kya hai? Is ki qeemat aur alamat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi substance ke aik mole mein maujood entities ki tadaad aik constant hai jise Avogadro's number kehte hain. Calculations mein is ki rounded qeemat 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ hai aur alamat Nₐ hai.

book_ref.quote: It is represented by Nₐ. This value is attributed to an Italian scientist

blocks.prompt:
6 Name the kind of particle counted in one mole of each: ¹²C, H₂O, NaCl and Na⁺.
(¹²C, H₂O, NaCl aur Na⁺ mein se har aik ke aik mole mein kis qisam ke particles gine jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har aik mein 6.02 × 10²³ particles hote hain: ¹²C mein atoms; H₂O mein molecules; NaCl mein formula units; Na⁺ mein ions.

book_ref.quote: 1 mole of Na⁺ contains 6.02 x 10²³ ions of Na⁺

blocks.prompt:
7 Define molar mass and give its unit.
(Molar mass ki definition aur unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi substance ke aik mole ka grams mein mass molar mass (M) kehlata hai. Yeh atomic, molecular, formula ya ionic mass ke barabar hai jab grams mein likha jaye. Unit: g/mol (g mol⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: The mass of one mole of a substance (element, compound or ionic species) is equal to the atomic mass

blocks.prompt:
8 Calculate the molar mass of CO₂ and of H₂SO₄. (H = 1.0, C = 12.0, O = 16.0, S = 32.0)
(CO₂ aur H₂SO₄ ka molar mass nikalein. (H = 1.0, C = 12.0, O = 16.0, S = 32.0))
blocks.explanation: Molar mass atoms ke masses ka majmooa hai. CO₂ = 12.0 + 2 × 16.0 = 44.0 g/mol. H₂SO₄ = 2 × 1.0 + 32.0 + 4 × 16.0 = 98.0 g/mol.

book_ref.quote: The molar mass is the sum of the masses of the component atoms

blocks.prompt:
9 Calculate the mass of 0.20 mol of CO₂ (molar mass 44.0 g mol⁻¹).
(0.20 mol CO₂ (molar mass 44.0 g mol⁻¹) ka mass nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: n = m/M se m = n × M = 0.20 mol × 44.0 g mol⁻¹ = 8.8 g.

book_ref.quote: The number of moles of a substance can be calculated by dividing mass in grams by molar mass

blocks.prompt:
10 How many moles are present in 49.0 g of H₂SO₄ (molar mass 98.0 g mol⁻¹)?
(49.0 g H₂SO₄ (molar mass 98.0 g mol⁻¹) mein kitne moles hain?)

book_ref.quote: Mass of HCl = Number of moles x Molar mass

blocks.text: 4.2 Relationship between mole, molar mass and Avogadro's number

blocks.prompt:
11 1.0 g of hydrogen and 238.0 g of uranium contain the same number of atoms. Justify.
(1.0 g hydrogen aur 238.0 g uranium mein atoms ki tadaad barabar hai. Saabit karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har mass us element ka grams mein molar mass hai, yani 1 mole. Har element ke 1 mole mein 6.02 × 10²³ atoms hote hain, is liye dono mein 6.02 × 10²³ atoms hain; bas uranium ka atom bohat bhari hai.

book_ref.quote: It is interesting to know that different masses of elements have the same number of atoms

blocks.prompt:
12 Compare one mole of water with one mole of glucose.
(Aik mole paani ka aik mole glucose se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif compounds ke aik mole ke mass mukhtalif magar molecules ki tadaad barabar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence, one mole of different compounds has different masses but the same number of molecules

rows: Mass = 18.0 g
Mass = 180.0 g
6.02 × 10²³ molecules
6.02 × 10²³ molecules

blocks.prompt:
13 How many moles are present in 3.01 × 10²² molecules of a substance?
(Kisi substance ke 3.01 × 10²² molecules mein kitne moles hain?)
blocks.explanation: Moles = particles ki tadaad / Nₐ = 3.01 × 10²² / 6.02 × 10²³ = 0.050 mol.

book_ref.quote: One can calculate the number of moles by dividing the number of particles by Avogadro

blocks.prompt:
14 Calculate the number of molecules in 0.36 g of water (molar mass 18.0 g mol⁻¹).
(0.36 g paani (molar mass 18.0 g mol⁻¹) mein kitne molecules hain?)
blocks.explanation: Particles = mass × Nₐ / molar mass = 0.36 × 6.02 × 10²³ / 18.0 = 1.204 × 10²² molecules (0.02 mol).

book_ref.quote: The relationship between amounts of substances in terms of their moles and the number of particles

blocks.prompt:
15 How many Na⁺ ions are present in 5.85 g of NaCl (molar mass 58.5 g mol⁻¹)?
(5.85 g NaCl (molar mass 58.5 g mol⁻¹) mein kitne Na⁺ ions hain?)
blocks.explanation: NaCl ke moles = 5.85/58.5 = 0.10 mol. Har formula unit mein aik Na⁺ hai, is liye Na⁺ = 0.10 × 6.02 × 10²³ = 6.02 × 10²² ions.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, the number of ions in one mole of different ionic species is always the same

blocks.prompt:
16 How are mass in grams, moles and number of particles inter-converted?
(Grams mein mass, moles aur particles ki tadaad aapas mein kaise badli jaati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mass (g) ÷ molar mass = moles; moles × molar mass = mass (g). Moles × Nₐ = particles ki tadaad; particles ÷ Nₐ = moles.

book_ref.quote: Mass in grams, moles and number of particles

blocks.prompt:
17 What is juglone? Why does it not harm grass around the black walnut tree?
(Juglone kya hai? Yeh black walnut ke ird gird ghaas ko nuqsaan kyun nahi deta?)
blocks.explanation: Juglone (C₁₀H₆O₃, molar mass 174 g/mol) black walnut ke chhilkon se banne wala dye (rang) hai. Yeh qudrati herbicide (jaree booti maarne wala) hai jo darakht ke ird gird muqabil podon ko maarta hai magar ghaas aur ghair-muqabil podon par asar nahi karta.

book_ref.quote: Juglone, is a dye and is produced from the husks of black walnuts

blocks.prompt:
18 A stinging bee releases about 1 μg of isopentyl acetate, C₇H₁₄O₂ (molar mass 130 g mol⁻¹). How many moles is this?
(Dank marti makkhi taqreeban 1 μg isopentyl acetate, C₇H₁₄O₂ (molar mass 130 g mol⁻¹), chhorti hai. Yeh kitne moles hain?)

book_ref.quote: bees release about 1 μg (1 × 10⁻⁶ g) of this compound when they sting

blocks.prompt:
19 What is the use of the molar volume relationship? Give its symbol and value.
(Molar volume ke taluq ka kya faida hai? Is ki alamat aur qeemat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Molar volume (Vₘ) STP par aik mole ideal gas ka volume hai, 22.414 dm³ (taqreeban 22.4 dm³). Is se STP par gas ka mass ya moles volume mein, aur volume wapas moles mein, badla ja sakta hai: V = n × Vₘ.

book_ref.quote: By using molar volume relationship, mass or mole of a gas at STP can be converted into volume

blocks.prompt:
20 State Avogadro's law.
(Avogadro's law bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Same temperature aur pressure par tamam ideal gases ke barabar volumes mein molecules ki tadaad barabar hoti hai. Is liye STP (273.15 K, 1 atm) par kisi bhi ideal gas ke 22.4 dm³ mein 6.02 × 10²³ molecules hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Equal volumes of all ideal gases at the same temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules

blocks.prompt:
21 22.4 dm³ of H₂ and 22.4 dm³ of CO₂ at STP have different masses but the same number of molecules. Explain.
(STP par 22.4 dm³ H₂ aur 22.4 dm³ CO₂ ke mass mukhtalif magar molecules barabar hain. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: STP par kisi bhi gas ke 22.4 dm³ = 1 mole, is liye dono mein 6.02 × 10²³ molecules hain. 1 mole ka mass molar mass hai: H₂ = 2 g magar CO₂ = 44.0 g, is liye mass mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: 22.4 dm³ of CO₂ at STP = 44.0 g of CO₂

blocks.prompt:
22 Find the volume occupied by 0.75 mol of NH₃ gas at STP.
(STP par 0.75 mol NH₃ gas ka volume nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: V = n × Vₘ = 0.75 mol × 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹ = 16.8 dm³.

book_ref.quote: calculate the volume of a gas by multiplying number of moles of the gas by molar volume

blocks.prompt:
23 Find the number of moles and the mass of 4.48 dm³ of CO₂ (molar mass 44.0 g mol⁻¹) at STP.
(STP par 4.48 dm³ CO₂ (molar mass 44.0 g mol⁻¹) ke moles aur mass nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: 22.4 dm³ of a gas at STP = Molar mass of a gas

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between molar mass and molar volume.
(Molar mass aur molar volume mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Molar mass aur molar volume mein farq:

book_ref.quote: The volume of one mole of an ideal gas at STP (Standard temperature and pressure) is called molar volume

rows: Kisi substance ke aik mole ka grams mein mass.
STP par aik mole ideal gas ka volume.
Elements, compounds aur ions sab par.
Gases par.
Har substance ka mukhtalif (H₂ = 2 g, CO₂ = 44.0 g).
Tamam ideal gases ka aik hi: 22.4 dm³.
Alamat M; unit g/mol.
Alamat Vₘ; unit dm³ (fi mole).

blocks.text: 4.4 Molar mass and density of gases

blocks.prompt:
25 Why does the density of a gas at STP depend on its molar mass?
(STP par gas ki density us ke molar mass par kyun munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: STP par har gas ka aik molar mass aik hi volume (22.4 dm³) gherta hai. Chunke d = m/V aur V barabar hai, zyada molar mass wali gas ki density zyada hoti hai, aur ulta bhi.

book_ref.quote: As molar mass of all the gases occupies same volume at STP, therefore, density of a gas depends on its molar mass

blocks.prompt:
26 A gas has a density of 3.17 g dm⁻³ at STP. Calculate its molar mass.
(Aik gas ki STP par density 3.17 g dm⁻³ hai. Is ka molar mass nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik mole ka mass = d × Vₘ = 3.17 g dm⁻³ × 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹ = 71.0 g mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: If the density of gas at STP is determined, its molar mass can be calculated

blocks.prompt:
27 Calculate the density of NH₃ gas (molar mass 17 g mol⁻¹) at STP.
(STP par NH₃ gas (molar mass 17 g mol⁻¹) ki density nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A gas having higher molar mass will have higher density and vice versa

blocks.prompt:
28 What is molar concentration? Write the relation between moles and molar concentration.
(Molar concentration kya hai? Moles aur molar concentration ka taluq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Molar concentration fi dm³ solution mein hal shuda substance ke moles hain; unit mol/dm³ (mol dm⁻³). C = n/V, ya n = C × V, jahan V solution ka volume dm³ mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Molar concentration of solutions is given as mol/dm³

blocks.prompt:
29 What mass of Na₂CO₃ (molar mass 106 g mol⁻¹) is needed to make 500 cm³ of a 0.10 mol dm⁻³ solution?
(500 cm³ 0.10 mol dm⁻³ solution banane ke liye kitna Na₂CO₃ (molar mass 106 g mol⁻¹) chahiye?)

book_ref.quote: where C is the molar concentration and V is the volume of the solution

blocks.prompt:
30 6.91 g of K₂CO₃ (molar mass 138.2 g mol⁻¹) is dissolved to make 250 cm³ of solution. Find its molar concentration.
(6.91 g K₂CO₃ (molar mass 138.2 g mol⁻¹) hal kar ke 250 cm³ solution banaya gaya. Molar concentration nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Molar mass of K₂CO₃ = 138.2 g mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
31 Write four ways of finding the number of moles of a substance.
(Kisi substance ke moles nikalne ke chaar tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation: n = mass / molar mass; n = particles ki tadaad / Nₐ; n = STP par gas ka volume / 22.4 dm³; n = molar concentration × solution ka volume (dm³).

book_ref.quote: Number of moles concept map

blocks.prompt:
32 Which quantities are used to establish quantitative relationships between reactants and products?
(Reactants aur products ke miqdaari taluqaat banane ke liye kaun si quantities istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mole, Avogadro's number, molar mass, molar volume aur molar concentration ki maloomat se balanced chemical equations ki madad se reactants aur products ke miqdaari taluqaat banaye jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: With the knowledge of mole, Avogadro’s number, molar mass, molar volume, and molar concentration

blocks.prompt:
33 Name the six types of stoichiometric relationships.
(Stoichiometric taluqaat ki chhe qismein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mole-mole, mass-mass, volume-volume, mole-mass, mole-volume aur mass-volume taluqaat.

book_ref.quote: The following types of relationship can be studied with the help of a balanced chemical equation

blocks.prompt:
34 Interpret the equation 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(l) in terms of moles and masses. (H = 1.0, O = 16.0)
(2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(l) ko moles aur masses ke lihaaz se bayan karein. (H = 1.0, O = 16.0))
blocks.explanation: Moles: 2 moles H₂, 1 mole O₂ se react kar ke 2 moles H₂O banati hai. Masses: 4 g H₂, 32 g O₂ se react kar ke 36 g H₂O banati hai (4 + 32 = 36, mass mehfooz).

book_ref.quote: To understand these relationships, we need to interpret information hidden in a balanced chemical equation

blocks.prompt:
35 Give the assumptions under which stoichiometric calculations hold, and say why a side reaction would spoil them.
(Stoichiometric calculations kin mafroozaat par durust hain, aur side reaction inhein kyun kharab kar dega?)
blocks.explanation: Mafroozaat: (1) tamam reactants poori tarah products ban jaate hain; (2) conservation of mass aur definite proportions ke qawaneen maane jaate hain; (3) koi side reaction nahi hota. Side reaction kuch reactant doosri cheezein banane mein laga dega, is liye equation se nikli miqdaar mail nahi khaye gi.

book_ref.quote: Law of conservation of mass and law of definite proportions are obeyed. 3) No side reaction occurs

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between a mole-mole and a mass-mass stoichiometric relationship.
(Mole-mole aur mass-mass stoichiometric taluq mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono balanced equation ki mole ratio istemal karte hain; farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: 1 mole of N₂ reacts with 3 moles of H₂ to form 2 moles of NH₃

rows: Di gayi aur poochhi gayi miqdaar dono moles mein.
Di gayi aur poochhi gayi miqdaar dono mass (g) mein.
Seedha mole ratio istemal hoti hai.
Mass → moles (÷ M), mole ratio, moles → mass (× M).
Misaal: N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃ mein diye gaye N₂ ke moles ke liye H₂ ke moles.
Misaal: 2Al + Fe₂O₃ → Al₂O₃ + 2Fe mein diye gaye Fe₂O₃ ke mass ke liye Al ka mass.

blocks.prompt:
37 How many moles of NH₃ are formed when 1.8 mol of H₂ reacts with excess N₂? N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g)
(1.8 mol H₂ zyada N₂ se react kare to kitne moles NH₃ banenge? N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g))
blocks.explanation: Mole ratio H₂ : NH₃ = 3 : 2. NH₃ ke moles = 2/3 × 1.8 = 1.2 mol.

book_ref.quote: 1 mole of N₂ needs H₂ to produce NH₃ = 3/1 = 3mol

blocks.prompt:
38 What volume of O₂ at STP is needed to burn 5.6 dm³ of CH₄ completely? CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g)
(STP par 5.6 dm³ CH₄ ko poori tarah jalane ke liye kitni O₂ chahiye? CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g))
blocks.explanation: STP par gases ki volume ratio mole ratio ke barabar hai: CH₄ : O₂ = 1 : 2. O₂ ka volume = 2 × 5.6 = 11.2 dm³.

book_ref.quote: 67.2 dm³ (3 mol) of H₂ produce ammonia = 44.8 dm³ (2 mol)

blocks.prompt:
39 Why is LiOH used in space vehicles? Write the equation.
(Space vehicles mein LiOH kyun istemal hota hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Solid LiOH saans se nikli CO₂ ko rehne ki jagah se hata deta hai, solid lithium carbonate aur maai paani bana kar: 2LiOH(s) + CO₂(g) → Li₂CO₃(s) + H₂O(l).

book_ref.quote: Solid lithium hydroxide LiOH is used in space vehicles

blocks.prompt:
40 How many moles of HCl are neutralized by 1.26 g of baking soda, NaHCO₃ (molar mass 84.0 g mol⁻¹)? NaHCO₃(s) + HCl(aq) → NaCl(aq) + H₂O(l) + CO₂(g)
(1.26 g baking soda, NaHCO₃ (molar mass 84.0 g mol⁻¹), kitne moles HCl neutralize karega? NaHCO₃(s) + HCl(aq) → NaCl(aq) + H₂O(l) + CO₂(g))
blocks.explanation: NaHCO₃ ke moles = 1.26/84.0 = 0.0150 mol. Mole ratio 1 : 1, is liye HCl = 0.0150 mol.

book_ref.quote: Moles of NaHCO₃ = 2.1 g / 84.0 g mol⁻¹ = 0.025 mol

blocks.prompt:
41 What mass of iron (55.8 g mol⁻¹) gives 1.12 dm³ of H₂ at STP with excess sulphuric acid? Fe(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → FeSO₄(aq) + H₂(g)
(Kitna iron (55.8 g mol⁻¹) zyada sulphuric acid se STP par 1.12 dm³ H₂ dega? Fe(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → FeSO₄(aq) + H₂(g))

book_ref.quote: Molar mass of Fe (M) = 55.8 g/mol

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is a large amount of an inexpensive reactant frequently supplied in chemical processes?
(Chemical amal mein aksar sasta reactant zyada miqdaar mein kyun diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Taake mehnga reactant poora ka poora matloob product mein badal jaye. (ii) Zyada se zyada product banane ke liye. (iii) Reaction ki raftaar barhane ke liye.

book_ref.quote: Frequently, a large amount of inexpensive reactant is supplied because of the following reasons

blocks.prompt:
43 When a fuel burns in a large quantity of oxygen, which reactant is limiting? Give a reason.
(Jab fuel zyada oxygen mein jalta hai to limiting reactant kaun sa hai? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Fuel limiting reactant hai. Reaction ke aakhir mein zaid oxygen bach jati hai jab ke fuel pehle khatam ho jata hai, aur pehle khatam hone wala reactant limiting kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: In this way, excess of oxygen is left behind at the end of reaction and the other reactant

blocks.prompt:
44 Why does a reaction stop even when one of the reactants is still present?
(Aik reactant abhi maujood ho phir bhi reaction kyun ruk jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Product ki miqdaar us reactant se mehdood hoti hai jo poora istemal ho jaye (limiting reactant). Us ke khatam hote hi reaction ruk jata hai aur mazeed product nahi banta, chahe excess reactant bacha rahe.

book_ref.quote: In this way, the amount of product that forms is limited by the reactant that is completely used

blocks.prompt:
45 Write the three steps for identifying the limiting reactant.
(Limiting reactant pehchanne ke teen qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Diye gaye reactants ki miqdaar se moles nikalein. (2) Balanced equation se har reactant ke product ke moles nikalein. (3) Sab se kam product dene wala limiting reactant hai; doosra excess hai.

book_ref.quote: To identify a limiting reactant, the following three steps are performed

blocks.prompt:
46 How does smothering put out a fire? Name substances used for it.
(Smothering aag kaise bujhati hai? Is ke liye istemal hone wali cheezon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aag fuel aur oxygen ka combustion (ihtiraaq) hai. Smothering maujood oxygen ko jalne ke liye zaroori had se kam kar deti hai, yani excess reactant ghata deti hai. Foams, inert gas aur CO₂ smothering ke liye moassar hain.

book_ref.quote: An effective way to quench a fire is smothering

blocks.prompt:
47 0.30 mol of NH₃ is mixed with 0.30 mol of CuO: 2NH₃(g) + 3CuO(s) → N₂(g) + 3Cu(s) + 3H₂O(g). Which is the limiting reactant?
(0.30 mol NH₃ ko 0.30 mol CuO se milaya gaya: 2NH₃(g) + 3CuO(s) → N₂(g) + 3Cu(s) + 3H₂O(g). Limiting reactant kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: NH₃ se N₂ = 1/2 × 0.30 = 0.15 mol; CuO se N₂ = 1/3 × 0.30 = 0.10 mol. CuO kam N₂ deta hai, is liye CuO limiting reactant hai (0.10 mol N₂ banegi).

book_ref.quote: Thus, CuO is the limiting reactant and the number of moles of N₂ produced will be 0.38 mol

blocks.prompt:
48 Write the balanced equation and the net ionic equation for the reaction of aqueous Na₂SO₄ with Pb(NO₃)₂.
(Aqueous Na₂SO₄ aur Pb(NO₃)₂ ke reaction ki balanced aur net ionic equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Balanced: Na₂SO₄(aq) + Pb(NO₃)₂(aq) → PbSO₄(s) + 2NaNO₃(aq). Net ionic: Pb²⁺(aq) + SO₄²⁻(aq) → PbSO₄(s); ions 1 : 1 nisbat mein react karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Since 0.05 mol dm⁻³ Pb(NO₃)₂ contains 0.05 mol dm⁻³ Pb²⁺ ions

blocks.prompt:
49 What is an excess reagent? How is the amount left over found?
(Excess reagent kya hai? Bachi hui miqdaar kaise nikali jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Woh reactant jo stoichiometry ke lihaaz se zyada ho aur aakhir mein bach jaye, excess (non-limiting) reagent hai. Bachi miqdaar = li gayi − istemal hui; istemal hui miqdaar limiting reactant se nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The reactants which are in larger amounts (according to stoichiometry of reaction) and remain unreacted

blocks.prompt:
50 4 g of H₂ (2 mol) is mixed with 48 g of O₂ (1.5 mol): 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(l). Find the limiting reactant and the mass of excess reactant left. (O₂ = 32 g mol⁻¹)
(4 g H₂ (2 mol) ko 48 g O₂ (1.5 mol) se milaya gaya: 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(l). Limiting reactant aur bachi hui excess miqdaar ka mass nikalein. (O₂ = 32 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: H₂ se paani = 2 mol; O₂ se paani = 2 × 1.5 = 3 mol. H₂ kam deta hai, is liye H₂ limiting. O₂ istemal = 1/2 × 2 = 1 mol; bachi O₂ = 1.5 − 1 = 0.5 mol = 0.5 × 32 = 16 g.

book_ref.quote: for 1 mole of H₂, ½ mole of O₂ is required

blocks.prompt:
51 In burning methane, CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g), 2.0 mol of CH₄ is mixed with 3.0 mol of O₂. How many moles of CO₂ form?
(Methane jalane mein, CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g), 2.0 mol CH₄ ko 3.0 mol O₂ se milaya gaya. Kitne moles CO₂ banenge?)
blocks.explanation: CH₄ se CO₂ = 2.0 mol; O₂ se CO₂ = 1/2 × 3.0 = 1.5 mol. O₂ limiting hai, is liye 1.5 mol CO₂ banegi (bachi CH₄ = 2.0 − 1.5 = 0.5 mol).

book_ref.quote: it is clear that the limiting reactant is O₂ because it produces lesser amount (moles) of product

blocks.text: 4.8 Theoretical yield, actual yield and percentage yield

blocks.prompt:
52 Why is the theoretical yield called the maximum amount of product?
(Theoretical yield ko product ki zyada se zyada miqdaar kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh balanced equation se is mafroozay par nikali jati hai ke limiting reactant poora product ban jaye, koi nuqsaan, side reaction ya backward reaction na ho. Koi asal reaction is se zyada nahi de sakta.

book_ref.quote: The theoretical yield is the maximum amount of the product that can be produced by a given amount of a reactant

blocks.prompt:
53 How do separation processes lower the actual yield of a product?
(Separation ke amal product ki actual yield kaise kam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Filtration, distillation, separating funnel, dhulai, sukhana aur crystallization agar theek na kiye jayen to kuch product zaya ho jata hai, is liye actual yield kam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The processes like filtration, separation by distillation, separation by a separating funnel, washing, drying and crystallization

blocks.prompt:
54 How does a competing side reaction affect the yield of a product?
(Muqabil side reaction product ki yield par kya asar dalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch reactants side reaction mein hissa le kar doosri cheezein bana dete hain, is liye matloob product ke liye kam reactant bachta hai; actual yield theoretical yield se kam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: So, in most of the reactions the actual yield is less than the theoretical yield

blocks.prompt:
55 Why is the yield of a reversible reaction reduced?
(Reversible reaction ki yield kyun kam hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reversible reaction mein products ulta react kar ke wapas reactants bante hain, is liye backward reaction product ki miqdaar kam kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A reaction may be reversible

blocks.prompt:
56 What is meant by the efficiency of a reaction? How is it expressed?
(Reaction ki efficiency se kya muraad hai? Ise kaise zahir kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Efficiency (karkardagi) batati hai ke mumkin product mein se kitna asal mein mila. Ise percentage yield se zahir karte hain: % yield = actual yield / theoretical yield × 100. Jitni zyada % yield, utni zyada efficiency.

book_ref.quote: The efficiency of a reaction is expressed by comparing the actual and theoretical yields

blocks.prompt:
57 A reaction has a theoretical yield of 20.0 g but only 17.0 g of product is obtained. Calculate the percentage yield.
(Aik reaction ki theoretical yield 20.0 g hai magar sirf 17.0 g product mila. Percentage yield nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: % yield = actual / theoretical × 100 = 17.0 / 20.0 × 100 = 85.0 %.

book_ref.quote: Greater the % age yield, higher will be the efficiency of reaction and vice versa

blocks.prompt:
58 Differentiate between actual yield and percentage yield.
(Actual yield aur percentage yield mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Actual yield aur percentage yield mein farq:

book_ref.quote: The amount of the products calculated from the balanced chemical equation represents the theoretical yield

rows: Reaction mein asal mein milne wala product.
Actual yield ka theoretical yield se muqabla, percentage mein.
Tajurbe se maloom hoti hai.
Hisaab se: actual / theoretical × 100.
Mass ki unit (g) hoti hai.
Mass ki unit nahi; % mein.
Misaal: 17.0 g product.

blocks.prompt:
59 In the preparation of aspirin from salicylic acid and acetic anhydride, which reactant controls the yield and why?
(Salicylic acid aur acetic anhydride se aspirin banane mein kaun sa reactant yield control karta hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Salicylic acid. Reactants 1 : 1 react karte hain aur salicylic acid ke moles acetic anhydride se kam liye gaye, is liye salicylic acid limiting reactant hai aur aspirin ki yield control karta hai; acetic anhydride excess hai.

book_ref.quote: Here, salicylic acid is limiting reactant while acetic anhydride is an excess reactant

blocks.text: 4.9 Importance of stoichiometry in production and dosage of medicine

blocks.prompt:
60 Why is stoichiometry important in the synthesis of drugs?
(Dawaon ki tayyari mein stoichiometry kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stoichiometry dawa ki tayyari ki durustagi yaqeeni banati hai. Koi bhi farq na-mukammal reaction ya bache reactants / by-products ki milawat ka sabab ban sakta hai. Is se chemists reactions ko theek control karte hain taake dawa moassar aur mehfooz ho.

book_ref.quote: Stoichiometry ensures the accuracy of drug synthesis

blocks.prompt:
61 Why must the dose of a medicine be calculated exactly?
(Dawa ki khurak theek theek kyun nikali jani chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Dawa kam miqdaar mein be-asar hai aur zyada miqdaar mein zehreeli halat ya maut ka sabab ban sakti hai. Misaal: paracetamol (dard aur bukhar ki dawa) ki over-dose aaza aur jigar (liver) ko shadeed nuqsaan de sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: To determine the amount and number of drugs to give a dosage to a patient

blocks.prompt:
62 Give four uses of stoichiometry in medicine.
(Medicine mein stoichiometry ke chaar istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Antibiotics mein har khurak active ingredient aur nishana bacteria se mutabiqat rakhti hai. (ii) Khoon mein cholesterol aur glucose ki satah (blood sugar ke liye insulin). (iii) Athletes ke peshaab mein steroids aur stimulants. (iv) Vaccines mein viral antigens ki concentration.

book_ref.quote: In the preparation of antibiotics, the stoichiometry ensures that each dose matches the active ingredient and target bacteria
